title: RAF Digby
label: Canadian Department of National Defence
comment: /* Post-war */ The Douglas Digby was named for the town of Digby Nova Scotia, not the Digby RAF/RCAF Station. The Douglas Digby was acquired and named in 1940 before the arrival of Canadians at RAF Digby. Note that in similar fashion, the Consolidated Catalina as manufactured for the RCAF was named the Canso after Canso, Nova Scotia. Ref Christopher Shores, "History of the Royal Canadian Air Force", p32 .
